changelog:
- Initial release of git-guardian skill.
- Enforces a git-tracked, diff-first workflow for all agent file creation and modification.
- Requires feature branches for changes and prevents direct commits to main.
- Automatically shows diffs for user review before applying changes; waits for approval.
- Provides scripts for common git operations to streamline the process.
- Excludes secrets, ephemeral files, and large binaries from tracking.
summary: Track all agent work in git and show diffs before applying changes. Use when: (1) creating or modifying scripts, configs, skills, or any workspace files, (2)...
